description: Step 1 of 2 for attaching a document to a reply to a message from Moneda (only when get_moneda_message shows `reply.attachment` optional or required). Returns a presigned S3 PUT URL (`uploadUrl`), a signed `uploadKey` and a literal `curlCommand` to run in your code sandbox; the file bytes go straight to S3 and never enter the conversation. After the PUT succeeds, pass `uploadKey` to reply_to_moneda_message. PDF, JPEG or PNG, max 5 MB; the slot expires in 15 minutes. Only upload a file the user chose for this reply.

fileSizeBytes.description: Exact file size in bytes (e.g. `wc -c <file>`). Signed into the URL: the PUT fails if the body differs.

name: request_message_reply_upload
